editorial:
Three friends find themselves in a wild mess when a bunch of mummies suddenly wake up and start causing trouble. What starts as a simple rescue mission to save their buddy quickly turns into something much bigger, and the gang realizes they've walked straight into a trap. The whole thing has a fun, spooky energy that never takes itself too seriously, making it easy to sit back and enjoy the ride with your family on a weekend night.

The animation is bright and playful, and the jokes land well for both kids and adults. The voice cast brings a lot of charm to the characters. The pacing stays quick, though the middle section drags a bit before the big finale. If you enjoy lighthearted adventure comedies, this one is a solid pick for movie night. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your collection.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the friends discover the mummy awakening was planned all along by a villain who wanted to lure them into the tomb. The pal they were trying to rescue was never in real danger and was part of the setup. The friends team up with a friendly mummy to stop the villain, break the curse, and escape the tomb just as it collapses. Everyone makes it out safe, and the mummies return to their resting places.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family adventure comedies with a spooky twist.
